report.summary: Every tagged sentence was traced to its cited page and no embedded specific failed: the share count and ₹10 face value (p29), the ₹1,130 lakh working-capital object (p48), the 44,28,000-share offer and blank price, the 57% Indian Railways revenue (p12), the 52% Western Railway order book (p65), the promoter's 74,95,476 shares / 90.949% (p100), the five-year P&L and balance-sheet tables (p26, p27, p111), the ₹68.4/₹57.7/₹324.3 lakh related-party figures (p129/p130) and the ratio figures (p54/p55) all reconcile exactly to the excerpts, including the rupee-to-crore conversions. Two entries are meta-statements about what the excerpts do or do not contain (tag indices 28 and 46) and are marked no-claim/supported rather than factual claims about the company. The report's framing sentences — that the issue price is undisclosed, that no peer identity is given, and that no competitor is named — are consistent with the supplied excerpts. No untagged sentence was found to make a checkable company-specific claim, so the sourcing is sound and blocking_count is zero.
